mock_data.title: Job Losses
mock_data.passage:
Gentlemen, I have here a memo from our parent company in the United States which contains important news for us all. The decision has been made to adopt a global policy of rationalization. As each company is autonomous, we have all been asked to propose a plan of restructuring and to send details of this as soon as possible. This will inevitably involve redundancies, but the board of directors here can do nothing to prevent this. Our hands are tied.

We have here copies of our plan and it is hoped, gentlemen, that you will cooperate with us in trying to implement this as effectively and speedily as possible. Obviously, we would wish, where possible, to give people early retirement or voluntary redundancy, rather than impose compulsory redundancy on anyone. You will note that generous redundancy packages have been outlined.

We hope that both you and your members will see these redundancies as a way of conserving jobs. In the present climate, only companies which are prepared to rationalize their workforce will survive. Those who do not will go to the wall. We are confident that if the recommendations are carried out, the company worldwide, and our part of it in particular, will be able to weather the storm.

You know how tough the market is just now and you also know that recently we have had rather a rocky ride in some parts of the country. It is a question of the survival of the fittest and we must make ourselves fit. This means slimming down our workforce.

We appreciate that your members will be concerned to learn of the proposed job cuts, but we hope that they will accept them as being inevitable. If the workers do try to oppose these cuts, they will be on a hiding to nothing. It has been made clear to us that any industrial action, or threat of it, is likely to put more jobs in jeopardy.

We would like you to inform your members that the proposed job cuts will apply to all members of staff, to management, office workers and factory workers alike. Be assured that this is not a case of there being one law for the rich and another for the poor, so to speak.

We hope that you will have fruitful negotiations with your members and let us know as soon as possible the outcome of these negotiations.

Thank you.
mock_data.passageB1:
Hello everyone. I have a message from our main company in the United States with some important news. They have decided to make a global plan to work more efficiently. This means each company needs to create a plan to change its structure. We need to send these plans as soon as possible. This will probably mean some people will lose their jobs, but the board of directors here can't stop it. We have no choice.

We have copies of our plan here. We hope you will work with us to make this happen quickly and well. We want to offer people early retirement or the chance to leave voluntarily if possible, instead of making anyone leave. You will see that there are good severance packages for those who leave.

We hope you and your members will see these job losses as a way to save other jobs. In today's world, only companies that can reduce their workforce will survive. Those that don't will fail. We believe that if we do what we plan, the company, especially our part of it, will get through this difficult time.

You know the market is very difficult right now. You also know that we have had some problems recently in some areas. We need to be strong to survive. This means we need to make our company smaller by reducing the number of workers.

We know your members will be worried about the proposed job cuts. We hope they will understand that they are unavoidable. If the workers try to fight these cuts, they will not succeed. We have been told that any strikes or threats of strikes could put even more jobs at risk.

We want you to tell your members that the job cuts will affect everyone: managers, office workers, and factory workers. This is not a situation where some people are treated better than others. Everyone will be treated the same.

We hope you will have good discussions with your members. Please let us know the results of these discussions as soon as you can.

Thank you.

Since each branch operates independently, we've all been asked to submit a restructuring plan with details as soon as possible. This will undoubtedly lead to layoffs, and the board of directors here has limited power to prevent it. Our options are constrained.

We have copies of our proposed plan, and we hope you'll cooperate with us to implement it as efficiently and quickly as possible. Our priority is to offer early retirement packages or voluntary redundancy options whenever possible, rather than resorting to compulsory redundancy. You'll find details of generous severance packages outlined in the plan.

We hope you and your members will see these reductions as a way to safeguard remaining jobs. In the current economic climate, only companies that are willing to downsize their workforce will survive. Those that don't will go out of business. We are confident that if the recommendations are followed, the company as a whole, and our division in particular, will be able to weather the economic downturn.

You’re aware of the current market challenges, and you also know that we've experienced some turbulence in certain regions recently. It’s a matter of survival, and we must become more competitive. This requires reducing our workforce.

We understand that your members will be concerned about the proposed job cuts, but we hope they will accept them as unavoidable. Any attempts to resist these cuts will be futile. We've been informed that any industrial action, or even the threat of it, is likely to jeopardize even more jobs. We want to emphasize that this decision was not taken lightly.

Please inform your members that the proposed job cuts will affect all staff members, including management, office staff, and factory workers. Rest assured that this is not a case of preferential treatment for certain groups.

We hope you will have productive discussions with your members and inform us of the outcome as soon as possible. We need to gauge the overall sentiment and mitigate any potential disruptions.

Thank you.
mock_data.passageC1:
Gentlemen, I am writing to you today to relay information received from our parent company in the United States concerning a significant shift in global strategy. The decision has been taken to implement a worldwide rationalisation programme. Given the operational autonomy of each subsidiary, we have been tasked with formulating a restructuring plan and submitting its details at the earliest opportunity. Regrettably, this will inevitably entail redundancies, a situation the board of directors here is powerless to avert; our latitude in this matter is severely constrained.

Enclosed are copies of our proposed plan. We trust that you will collaborate with us in its swift and effective implementation. Our preference, wherever feasible, is to offer early retirement or voluntary redundancy packages as alternatives to the imposition of compulsory redundancies. As you will observe, the redundancy packages outlined are, we believe, appropriately generous.

It is our sincere hope that you and your members will perceive these necessary workforce reductions as a measure designed to safeguard the viability of the remaining positions. In the current economic climate, only those companies prepared to streamline their operations and consolidate their resources will ultimately survive. Those that fail to do so will, regrettably, succumb to market pressures. We remain confident that, provided these recommendations are diligently implemented, the company as a whole, and our division in particular, will be able to weather this period of economic turbulence.

You are undoubtedly aware of the prevailing market volatility and the recent challenges we have encountered in various regions. It is a matter of survival of the fittest, and to that end, we must enhance our competitiveness. This necessitates a reduction in our overall workforce. The proposed downsizing exercise is essential for our future.

We fully anticipate that your members will be deeply concerned by the prospect of these job cuts. However, we urge them to accept these measures as unavoidable. Any attempts to resist these changes will, in all likelihood, prove futile. We have been explicitly informed that any industrial action, or even the threat thereof, is likely to jeopardise even more jobs. Such measures could exacerbate the situation.

We would ask you to inform your members that the proposed job cuts will apply across the board, affecting all levels of staff, from management and office personnel to factory floor employees. Let me assure you that this is not a case of differential treatment; the impact will be felt equitably across the organization. There will be no disparity in the application of these measures.

We anticipate constructive dialogue with your members and request that you inform us of the outcome of these negotiations at your earliest convenience. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this challenging period.

mock_data.translation:
Janoblar, menda Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlaridagi bosh kompaniyamizdan barcha uchun muhim yangiliklarni o'z ichiga olgan memorandum bor. Global ratsionalizatsiya siyosatini qabul qilish to'g'risida qaror qabul qilindi. Har bir kompaniya avtonom bo'lgani uchun, hammamizdan qayta tashkil etish rejasini taklif qilishimiz va bu haqidagi tafsilotlarni imkon qadar tezroq yuborishimiz so'raldi. Bu muqarrar ravishda ishdan bo'shatishlarni o'z ichiga oladi, ammo bu yerdagi direktorlar kengashi buni oldini olishga hech narsa qila olmaydi. Qo'llarimiz bog'langan.

Bu yerda rejamizning nusxalari bor va janoblar, sizlar buni iloji boricha samarali va tez amalga oshirishda biz bilan hamkorlik qilasiz deb umid qilamiz. Albatta, biz imkon bo'lsa, odamlarga erta pensiya yoki ixtiyoriy ishdan bo'shatishni berishni xohlaymiz, majburiy ishdan bo'shatishni hech kimga majburlamasdan. E'tibor bering, saxiy ishdan bo'shatish kompensatsiya paketlari belgilab qo'yilgan.

Umid qilamizki, siz ham, a'zolaringiz ham bu ishdan bo'shatishlarni ish o'rinlarini saqlab qolish usuli sifatida ko'rasizlar. Hozirgi sharoitda faqat ishchi kuchini ratsionalizatsiya qilishga tayyor bo'lgan kompaniyalar omon qoladi. Buni qilmaganlar barbod bo'ladi. Agar tavsiyalar amalga oshirilsa, butun dunyo bo'ylab kompaniya va ayniqsa bizning qismimiz bo'rondan omon chiqishga qodir bo'ladi deb ishonchimiz komil.

Siz hozirgi vaqtda bozor qanchalik qiyin ekanini bilasiz va yaqinda mamlakatning ba'zi qismlarida juda qiyin vaqt o'tkazganimizni ham bilasiz. Bu eng kuchlilarning omon qolishi masalasi va biz o'zimizni mos qilishimiz kerak. Bu ishchi kuchimizni kamaytirishni anglatadi.

A'zolaringiz taklif qilinayotgan ish qisqartishlari haqida bilishdan xavotirlanishini tushunamiz, lekin ular buni muqarrar deb qabul qilishlariga umid qilamiz. Agar ishchilar bu qisqartishlarga qarshi turishga harakat qilsalar, ular hech narsaga erisha olmaydilar. Bizga har qanday ishchilar harakati yoki uning tahdidi ko'proq ish joylarini xavf ostiga qo'yishi mumkinligi aniq qilib aytilgan.

A'zolaringizga taklif qilingan ish qisqartishlari barcha xodimlar, boshqaruv, ofis ishchilari va zavod ishchilariga bir xil taalluqli ekanligini bildirmoqchimiz. Ishonch hosil qiling, bu boylar uchun bir qonun va kambag'allar uchun boshqa qonun mavjud holat emas.

Umid qilamizki, siz a'zolaringiz bilan samarali muzokaralar o'tkazasiz va bu muzokaralarning natijalarini imkon qadar tezroq bizga xabar qilasiz.

Rahmat.

mock_data.translationB1:
Assalomu alaykum hurmatli hamkasblar. Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlaridagi bosh kompaniyamizdan muhim xabar keldi. Ular samaraliroq ishlash uchun global reja tuzishga qaror qilishdi. Bu har bir kompaniya o'z tuzilmasini o'zgartirish rejasini tuzishi kerakligini anglatadi. Biz bu rejalarni imkon qadar tezroq yuborishimiz kerak. Bu, ehtimol, ba'zi odamlar ish joylarini yo'qotishini anglatadi, lekin bu yerdagi direktorlar kengashi buni to'xtata olmaydi. Bizda boshqa iloj yo'q.

Bizda rejamizning nusxalari bor. Biz siz bu ishni tez va yaxshi amalga oshirish uchun biz bilan hamkorlik qilasiz deb umid qilamiz. Biz hech kimni majburan ishdan bo'shatmasdan, iloji bo'lsa, odamlarga erta pensiyaga chiqish yoki ixtiyoriy ravishda ketish imkoniyatini taklif qilmoqchimiz. Siz ishdan ketganlar uchun yaxshi ishdan bo'shatish to'lovlari borligini ko'rasiz.

Siz va a'zolaringiz ushbu ishdan bo'shatishlarni boshqa ish o'rinlarini saqlab qolish usuli sifatida ko'rasiz deb umid qilamiz. Bugungi kunda faqat ishchi kuchini qisqartira oladigan kompaniyalar omon qoladi. Buni qilmaganlar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraydi. Agar biz rejalashtirganimizni qilsak, kompaniya, ayniqsa uning biz tomoni, bu qiyin davrdan o'tadi deb ishonamiz.

Bilasiz, bozor hozir juda qiyin. Shuningdek, yaqinda ba'zi sohalarda muammolar bo'lganini ham bilasiz. Omon qolish uchun biz kuchli bo'lishimiz kerak. Bu esa, ishchilar sonini kamaytirish orqali kompaniyamizni kichraytirishimiz kerakligini anglatadi.

Biz sizning a'zolaringiz taklif qilinayotgan ishdan bo'shatishlar haqida xavotirlanishini bilamiz. Ular bu muqarrar ekanligini tushunishadi deb umid qilamiz. Agar ishchilar bu qisqartirishlarga qarshi kurashishga harakat qilsalar, ular muvaffaqiyat qozonmaydilar. Bizga har qanday ish tashlashlar yoki ish tashlash tahdidlari yanada ko'proq ish o'rinlarini xavf ostiga qo'yishi mumkinligi aytildi.

Biz sizdan a'zolaringizga ishdan bo'shatishlar hamma: menejerlar, ofis xodimlari va zavod ishchilariga ta'sir qilishini aytishingizni xohlaymiz. Bu ba'zi odamlarga boshqalarga qaraganda yaxshiroq munosabatda bo'linadigan vaziyat emas. Hammaga bir xil munosabatda bo'linadi.

Siz a'zolaringiz bilan yaxshi munozaralar o'tkazasiz deb umid qilamiz. Iltimos, bu munozaralarning natijalarini imkon qadar tezroq bizga xabar bering.

Rahmat.
mock_data.translationB2:
Assalomu alaykum. Men sizga AQShdagi bosh ofisimizdan kelgan xabarnomani yetkazmoqdaman, unda muhim yangiliklar bor. Global soddalashtirish siyosatini amalga oshirish to'g'risida qaror qabul qilindi. Har bir filial mustaqil ravishda faoliyat yuritgani sababli, barchamizdan imkon qadar tezroq qayta qurish rejasini batafsil ma'lumotlar bilan taqdim etish so'raldi. Bu, shubhasiz, ishdan bo'shatishlarga olib keladi va bu yerdagi direktorlar kengashi buni oldini olish uchun cheklangan vakolatlarga ega. Bizning imkoniyatlarimiz cheklangan.

Bizda taklif etilayotgan rejamizning nusxalari bor va biz siz biz bilan hamkorlik qilib, uni imkon qadar samarali va tezroq amalga oshirasiz degan umiddamiz. Bizning ustuvor vazifamiz - muddatidan oldin pensiyaga chiqish paketlarini yoki iloji boricha ixtiyoriy ravishda ishdan bo'shash imkoniyatlarini taklif qilish, majburiy ravishda ishdan bo'shatishga murojaat qilmaslikdir. Rejada saxiy ishdan bo'shatish to'lovlari haqida batafsil ma'lumot topishingiz mumkin.

Umid qilamizki, siz va sizning a'zolaringiz ushbu qisqartirishlarni qolgan ish o'rinlarini saqlab qolish usuli sifatida qabul qilasiz. Hozirgi iqtisodiy sharoitda faqatgina ishchi kuchini qisqartirishga tayyor bo'lgan kompaniyalar omon qoladi. Bunday qilmaganlar bankrot bo'ladi. Agar tavsiyalar bajarilsa, kompaniya umuman va bizning bo'limimiz xususan iqtisodiy tanazzulni bartaraf eta olishiga ishonchimiz komil.

Siz hozirgi bozor muammolaridan xabardorsiz va yaqinda ayrim hududlarda turbulentlikni boshdan kechirganimizni ham bilasiz. Bu omon qolish masalasi va biz yanada raqobatbardosh bo'lishimiz kerak. Buning uchun ishchi kuchimizni qisqartirish talab etiladi.

Biz sizning a'zolaringiz taklif etilayotgan ishdan bo'shatishlar haqida xavotirlanishlarini tushunamiz, ammo ular buni muqarrar deb qabul qilishlariga umid qilamiz. Ushbu qisqartirishlarga qarshi har qanday urinishlar befoyda bo'ladi. Bizga ma'lum qilishlaricha, har qanday sanoat harakati yoki hatto uning tahdidi ham ko'proq ish o'rinlarini xavf ostiga qo'yishi mumkin. Biz ushbu qaror yengil qabul qilinmaganini ta'kidlamoqchimiz.

Iltimos, a'zolaringizga taklif etilayotgan ishdan bo'shatishlar barcha xodimlarga, shu jumladan, menejment, ofis xodimlari va zavod ishchilariga ta'sir qilishini ma'lum qiling. Ishonchimiz komilki, bu ayrim guruhlarga imtiyozli munosabat emas.

Umid qilamizki, siz a'zolaringiz bilan samarali muhokamalar o'tkazasiz va natijalar haqida imkon qadar tezroq bizga xabar berasiz. Biz umumiy kayfiyatni baholashimiz va har qanday mumkin bo'lgan buzilishlarni yumshatishimiz kerak.

mock_data.translationC1:
Janoblar, bugun sizlarga Qo'shma Shtatlardagi bosh kompaniyamizdan olingan global strategiyadagi sezilarli o'zgarishlar haqidagi ma'lumotni yetkazmoqdaman. Butun dunyo bo'ylab ratsionalizatsiya dasturini amalga oshirish to'g'risida qaror qabul qilindi. Har bir sho'ba korxonasining operatsion mustaqilligini hisobga olgan holda, bizga qayta qurish rejasini ishlab chiqish va uning tafsilotlarini imkon qadar tezroq taqdim etish vazifasi yuklatildi. Afsuski, bu muqarrar ravishda xodimlarni qisqartirishga olib keladi, bu yerda direktorlar kengashi oldini olishga ojiz bo'lgan vaziyat; bu masalada bizning erkinligimiz juda cheklangan.

Ilova qilingan holda bizning taklif etilayotgan rejamizning nusxalari keltirilgan. Biz siz bilan uning tez va samarali amalga oshirilishida hamkorlik qilishingizga ishonamiz. Iloji boricha, biz majburiy qisqartirishlarni joriy etish o'rniga, erta pensiyaga chiqish yoki ixtiyoriy qisqartirish paketlarini taklif qilishni afzal ko'ramiz. Ko'rib turganingizdek, qisqartirish paketlari bizning fikrimizcha, yetarlicha saxovatli.

Siz va a'zolaringiz ushbu zaruriy ishchi kuchini qisqartirishni qolgan lavozimlarning yashash qobiliyatini himoya qilishga qaratilgan chora sifatida qabul qilasizlar degan chin dildan umid qilamiz. Hozirgi iqtisodiy sharoitda faqat o'z faoliyatini soddalashtirishga va resurslarini birlashtirishga tayyor bo'lgan kompaniyalar oxir-oqibat omon qoladi. Buni amalga oshira olmaganlar, afsuski, bozor bosimiga dosh bera olmaydi. Ushbu tavsiyalar qat'iy amalga oshirilsa, kompaniya umuman va bizning bo'limimiz xususan, iqtisodiy beqarorlikning ushbu davrini yengib o'ta oladi degan ishonchdamiz.

Siz, albatta, bozorning hozirgi beqarorligi va yaqinda turli hududlarda duch kelgan muammolarimizdan xabardorsiz. Bu eng kuchlilarning omon qolishi masalasidir va shu maqsadda biz raqobatbardoshligimizni oshirishimiz kerak. Bu esa umumiy ishchi kuchimizni qisqartirishni talab qiladi. Taklif etilayotgan hajmni qisqartirish kelajagimiz uchun zarur.

Biz sizning a'zolaringiz ushbu ishdan bo'shatish istiqbolidan chuqur tashvishlanishini to'liq kutamiz. Biroq, biz ularni ushbu choralarni muqarrar deb qabul qilishga chaqiramiz. Ushbu o'zgarishlarga qarshilik ko'rsatishga urinishlar, ehtimol, befoyda bo'ladi. Bizga har qanday sanoat harakati yoki hatto uning tahdidi ham yanada ko'proq ishlarni xavf ostiga qo'yishi mumkinligi haqida aniq ma'lumot berildi. Bunday choralar vaziyatni yanada og'irlashtirishi mumkin.

Sizdan a'zolaringizga taklif etilayotgan ishdan bo'shatishlar barcha darajadagi xodimlarga, boshqaruv va ofis xodimlaridan tortib zavod ishchilarigacha ta'sir qilishini ma'lum qilishingizni so'raymiz. Ishontirib aytamanki, bu differensial munosabat emas; ta'sir tashkilot bo'ylab teng taqsimlanadi. Ushbu choralarni qo'llashda tafovut bo'lmaydi.

Biz a'zolaringiz bilan konstruktiv muloqot qilishni kutamiz va ushbu muzokaralar natijalari haqida imkon qadar tezroq bizni xabardor qilishingizni so'raymiz. Ushbu qiyin davrda tushunishingiz va hamkorligingiz uchun minnatdormiz.
